scope: structural reachability of the frozen v1.4.1 mastery/transfer policy
non_claims: This is an engineering reachability gate, not evidence of learning efficacy.
It does not establish that two retrieval items are pedagogically sufficient.
It does not modify or validate the 14-day retention interval.
checks: Every skill containing a transfer item has at least two distinct non-transfer retrieval items.
Correct answers to two distinct non-transfer items make transferReady true for that skill when evidence is fresh.
Prerequisite-dependent skills become unlocked after their prerequisite skills satisfy the same readiness gate.
Repeated success on only one non-transfer item never makes transferReady true.
repair_constraint: Add independent retrieval opportunities or otherwise restore reachability without weakening the two-distinct-item mastery-ready invariant.
